newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank injects 115.8 mln kuna repo funds.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank injects 115.8 mln kuna repo funds.

text.p: Croatia's central bank said it injected 115.8 million kuna into the banking system on Friday through a repo deal.
It bought from commercial banks outstanding 35- and 91-day liquidity bills nominally worth 116 million kuna.
The deal expires on February 18. The bills will be due for repurchase at a weighted rate of 8.44 percent, the bank said. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
